subject: design/routing-evidence-v1
statement: `routing-evidence-producer-policy/v1` is a closed matrix over event kind, producer role, repository identity class, implementation generation, and required authorization proof. Operator-authorized repository config exact-identifies the policy digest, trusted Ed25519 public keys, allowed event classes and generations for each key, the evidence ref, and its genesis commit. A short-lived producer receives only the private signing capability for its declared class/generation. `routing-evidence-producer-proof/v1` is the key ID, algorithm, and deterministic Ed25519 signature over domain `routing-evidence-producer-proof/v1` plus the exact canonical `unsigned_envelope` from §3.1. Repository, ref, event ID/type, content digest, producer class, and generation are already closed fields in that signed envelope; the proof object itself is excluded from all three preimages. Replay across event kind, repository, ref, generation, or content therefore fails.
